name: Madcap Top Effect
descr: Roll 1d20 and use the matching result range. [Open the source entry](/item/madcap-top-gm-core) for context.
rows: You spin just like the top. You are Stunned for 1 round and then Confused for 1 round.
A 3rd-rank Illusory Disguise makes you look like the target.
A statue of the target, made of chocolate or candy, appears adjacent to you.
Gravity reverses, sending you and the target 30 feet in the air, immobilized. You both fall at the start of your next turn.
Mind Reading affects the target, and the top loudly recites what it discovers.
A fountain erupts from the top, spraying wine for 10 minutes.
Translocate affects you, but you teleport through Hell.
Four singing skeletons appear to serenade you and your allies for 1 minute, granting a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.
The top flings 1 cp at you.
You and the target change places; this is a teleportation effect.
Banishment affects the target, or paralyze if the target's on its home plane.
Rainbow dye explodes and covers you for 24 hours.
The top creates a Toxic Cloud centered on the target.
A random unattended object within 60 feet of you sprouts animal legs and follows you, reverting when the top's activation recharges.
Spin again, and the target also spins as though it had activated the top.
